withheld.label: Fovea of femoral head
withheld.reason: The 963-vertex reduced femur has a smooth triangulated head; no reliably identifiable foveal depression or source segmentation survives. A guessed patch on the head would imply an observed landmark.
withheld.nextEvidenceNeeded: A higher-resolution femoral-head surface or manually registered fovea annotation on this donor.

withheld.label: Groove for flexor hallucis longus on talus
withheld.reason: The small posterior talar tubercles are merged/simplified in this 776-vertex mesh. Gray 79.9C does not label the posterior FHL groove, and the generic leader in 79.14A is not bone-specific. A line cannot be localized independently with sufficient confidence.
withheld.nextEvidenceNeeded: Higher-resolution posterior talus or donor-registered tubercle/groove annotation.
